prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: High fidelity desktop dashboard design concept, 1536x1024 landscape image.
Primary request: Design a beautiful, distinctive, genuinely usable personal job-search analytics portfolio web interface titled "Peak Unemployment". This is the editorial research journal / annual report direction. Ivory #f8f7f3 background, charcoal #222b28 typography and restrained rust #9e492e highlights. Broad confident masthead with large elegant editorial serif title and tagline exactly "Because apparently even unemployment needs KPIs." Small sans-serif navigation across the top: Overview, Applications, Methodology. Fine horizontal rules, elegant typographic hierarchy, ample whitespace. Flat crisp UI, no browser chrome.
Composition: At top, slender issue line "A personal job search, examined." with right aligned "SYNTHETIC DEMO · AS OF 2026-10-15". Below, beautiful broad serif masthead. Main content has narrow 230px facts-and-filters column on left, large 1100px analytical story area on right. Left column heading "The sample", oversized total 48 with label "Total tracked", and compact filters Date range / All time, Role family / All roles, Location / All locations, with small reset link. Tiny provenance note "Illustrative synthetic records. Fixed reporting date: 2026-10-15."
Right story area: Section number "01 / CURRENT STATUS", sophisticated serif headline "Where things stand." Small explanation "A snapshot of current status, not a conversion funnel." Borderless chart spread of a precisely labeled horizontal current-status path: Total tracked 48 → Discovered 5 → Preparing 4 → Applied 16 → Recruiter Screen 4 → Interview 3 → Technical 2 → Final 1 → Offer 1. The visual groups statuses along a fine line with compact bars or nodes and readable labels. Rejected 10 branches separately directly from Total tracked; Unknown 2 also separate. Do not show rejection as a sequential stage. No funnel taper; counts represent current status, not historical transitions.
Lower right section "02 / APPLICATION EXPLORER", elegant serif heading "The application ledger." Compact search field and a restrained Filter button, then polished ledger-style table with columns Role, Sector, Location, Current status, Applied. Show 4 legible rows of clearly synthetic examples, simple status labels and thin rules, no chunky rounded cards. Footer text "Reviewed synthetic examples only". Fit a substantial amount of table on screen.
Style: premium editorial financial annual-report meets functional analytics web app. Distinctive typography, large masthead plus narrow facts column rather than a persistent vertical navigation rail. Labels and controls must remain readable and plausible. All numerical information illustrative and labeled synthetic. Do not invent response rates, conversion rates, trend charts, or time-series values. No decorative images, textures, gradients, shadows, glass, excessive cards, or browser chrome. Output only the finished UI mockup image.
